## NeMo Customizer Tasks Container

This container image provides shared CPU task support for NeMo Helix customization workflows (automodel, unsloth, and RL). It hosts file I/O, model entity registration, model spec analysis, and the LoRA adapter sidecar.

### Resources

[Documentation](https://docs.nvidia.com/nemo-helix)
